notes: NEW subject pack: Calculus Basics — limits, the derivative as a rate of change, the power rule, the chain rule, the product rule, integrals as accumulation, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, and optimisation, with which-idea, power-rule, average-rate-of-change, and area-under-a-line practice, never your assignment.

Detector V34 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 12 of 18 humanized texts, below the shipped V20's 13 — so V20 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. The round's broader marker-balance design (800 real human texts at humanized-like marker density, now spanning informal and formal writing) gained one probe text and lost two; GPT-5 detection reached 95.1%, the best yet, with the false-flag rate at 4.37% (below V20's 4.71%), but neural-paraphrase detection slipped to 48.9%.
